verdict.rationale: Luma publishes per-model credit costs (e.g., 20 credits for a 5s 360p Draft T2V/I2V), so a marketer can work out a generation's cost in advance, and the docs link to a Billing Dashboard for tracking spend afterwards. There is no documented in-product cost preview before submitting a generation, and the Billing Dashboard is only named, not described. Missing for 10: a documented pre-run cost estimate shown in the UI or API, documented spend-tracking or usage-history features in the billing dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: The Luma API uses a credit system, not a subscription.
